article: PowerShellでプロセスのメインウィンドウタイトルを表示する
scope: Compared the complete Japanese source and all twelve translations, including explanatory text, terminology, PowerShell sample, official references, dates, and claims about the scope of enumerated windows.
findings: Removed the duplicate future publication date, retained 2022-09-20, and set lastmod to 2026-11-24 across the bundle.

Corrected the overbroad claim that Get-Process enumerates every open window. MainWindowTitle provides the main-window title associated with each process; entries without a nonempty title are filtered out.
Replaced the stale, machine-specific sample output with a PowerShell pipeline that also displays process name and ID.
Added a privacy note because window titles can reveal open document names or other personal information, and linked Microsoft Learn references in every language.

post/ウィンドウタイトルの列挙/index.en.md.source: post/ウィンドウタイトルの列挙/index.md
post/ウィンドウタイトルの列挙/index.en.md.summary: Compared the full translation with the Japanese article; corrected the claim to main-window titles per process, removed stale sample output, added process identifiers and privacy guidance, and linked the official API documentation.

meaning.note: Compared the complete article with the Japanese source and preserved the scope: one main-window title per process, with empty values omitted; it is not an enumeration of every desktop window.

terminology.note: Checked consistent translations of process, main window, window title, empty value, process name, and process ID while retaining PowerShell/.NET property and cmdlet identifiers.

mathematics.note: The article contains no mathematical formulas or calculations.

code.note: Statically checked the PowerShell pipeline, property spelling, Where-Object filter, and selected properties against the documented Process.MainWindowTitle API. The command was not executed because it would expose this machine's active window titles.

links.note: Added Microsoft Learn references for Get-Process and Process.MainWindowTitle in every locale; both pages were opened and checked during review.

limitations: AI-assisted review; no human or native-speaker certification.
PowerShell was reviewed statically and not run; executing it would expose this machine's current window titles.
The article documents one main-window-title property per process. It does not provide a method for enumerating every window owned by a process.
The result is time-dependent as processes start and exit; window titles may reveal document names or personal information.
